manifestations.description: Left ankle / foot pain (persistent, worsened after rupture)
Left foot numbness / decreased sensation of medial plantar surface
Limping gait and reduced walking tolerance (difficulty walking more than 1-2 hours; walking tolerance 15 minutes at times)
Depressed mood with auditory and visual hallucinations
Weakness of three toes of left foot

treatments_received: operative reconstruction of PTT with FHL transfer (28 September 2011)

losses.description: Limitation to standing / sitting tolerance and reduced walking tolerance (difficulty walking / standing for over 1-2 hours; limp; walking tolerance sometimes 15 minutes)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Stopped cycling; only swam occasionally; could not run; difficulty negotiating slopes and stairs

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Difficulty getting up from bed and inability to carry heavy objects
Decreased outdoor activities and social engagement due to pain and low mood
